# Andi Muchlas Ramadani - Software Engineer Portfolio

A retro terminal-themed portfolio (AMRSYS 9400) showcasing engineering expertise across backend services, AI/ML pipelines, and real-time interactive systems.

## Technical Skills
- Software Engineering: Go, TypeScript, Python, C#, REST APIs, gRPC (Protobuf), WebSocket
- Backend & Distributed Systems: PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Redis, NATS, BullMQ, Typesense, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (S3)
- AI / ML: PyTorch, DistilBERT, HuggingFace Transformers, FastAPI, Model Orchestration, STT/TTS Pipelines
- Geospatial: OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine), Uber H3 Hexagonal Grid, PostGIS, Geospatial ETL
- Real-Time & Interactive: Unity (C#), Oculus LipSync, MetaPerson Avatar SDK, LiDAR Sensor Integration, Projection Mapping

## Experience Summary
Software Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience building end-to-end systems across backend services, AI/ML pipelines, and real-time interactive applications. Experienced in Go and TypeScript backend architecture, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, distributed messaging, Kubernetes, and high-throughput geospatial systems, alongside Python/PyTorch model orchestration and Unity/C# real-time clients. Currently Backend Developer at PT Lintas Cakra Cipta and Freelance Unity Developer at Molca Teknologi Nusantara.

## Key Projects
- Rajaderek: Real-time spatial routing and logistics system (Go, TypeScript, PostGIS, OSRM, Uber H3, Typesense, Kubernetes, NATS, Redis)
- AI Avatar Unity: Real-time conversational AI avatar with voice pipeline & lip-sync (Unity, Python, Docker, PyTorch, Oculus LipSync, MetaPerson)
- Intelligent LLM Intent Router: 5-dimension DistilBERT semantic model routing engine (Python, PyTorch, Transformers, FastAPI)
- Enterprise Genset Management: Clean Architecture rental & maintenance backend (Node.js, TypeScript, Hono, Drizzle ORM, Redis, BullMQ)
- Casanela Villa API: High-throughput villa reservation engine (Bun, TypeScript, Hono, PostgreSQL, BullMQ, S3)
